Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original

delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. The bidder must submit an Undertaking of non-blacklisting on company letterhead/Stamp affidavit. 2. The bidder must submit the Experience Certificate, Bidders turnover of last 3 years. 3. The rates shall be inclusive of all taxes, duties and other freight charges and delivery of firewood to the ssp traffic city srinangar 4. There will be no compromise on the quality of the product supplied; materials must conform to the certif ied standards as per specified by the department. 5. The successful bidder shall have to make the supply within 15 days or within the stipulated supply perio d. 6. Rejection wood must be delivered to locations viz SSp traffic city office at the bidder's own expense. No additional freight, loading, or unloading charges shall be entertained. 8. All disputes arising out of the bidding process shall be settled in accordance with the Arbitration and Co nciliation Act, 1996. The jurisdiction for all legal proceedings shall be the courts situated at Srinagar only, s ubject to overriding provisions for statutory remedies. 7. The buyer reserves the right to terminate the contract if it does not conform to the agreed specification, quantity and delivery schedule. 9.Sample should be submitted to the department before end date of the bid 10.
